annotations.title: Add a knowledge source to an agent

description:
Add a knowledge source to an agent

Adds one knowledge source to a voice agent. The body is one of three shapes chosen by `type`: `url` reads one page and reads it again every `syncInterval` (weekly by default), `text` takes up to 200000 characters of `text` to store verbatim, `crawl` reads a whole website from its start page, up to `maxDepth` links deep and `maxPages` pages, and crawls it again every `syncInterval`. A crawl runs in the background with status `pending`; follow it with `GET /agents/{agentId}/knowledge/crawl`. `title` is optional and defaults to the URL, the host name for a crawl, or to "Text Knowledge" for a text entry. Files go through `POST /agents/{agentId}/knowledge/files`. The document is created in the voice engine and then attached to the agent, which from then on draws on it in calls. The entry is stored under the account that owns the agent, also when a reseller key adds it. When the document cannot be created or attached, the request still succeeds and the entry is stored with status `failed`; delete it and add it again.

agentId.description: Identifier of the voice agent. Accepted either as the public form `agent_12` or as the bare number `12`; the prefix is stripped before the lookup.

body.description: A page, a text or a website. Set `type` to `url` and send `url`, to `text` and send `text`, or to `crawl` and send the start page as `url`.

syncInterval.description: How often the page is read again. Defaults to weekly, `off` reads it once.

title.description: Human-readable title for this knowledge source

url.description: Web URL to crawl and index as knowledge
